d: When the Jump Street unit is faced wave of crack-related deaths, officer Penhall suspects that a hired outside police expert is responsible.
The Jump Street squad puts a sting on a bar serving alcohol to under-age kids and ironically has to cope with the drunk driving arrest of their own captain.
Captain Fuller and officer Hoffs go undercover on a violent high school campus where both student and faculty carry lethal weapons just to stay alive.

As Burgard High students and faculty sit on a powder keg of racial tension, officers Hanson and Hoffs go undercover to diffuse the potentially explosive situation in the racially divided high school.

d: When an Olympic-bound gymnast dies of complications linked to a steroid overdose, Officers Penhall and Hoffs go undercover on the athletically competitive Augustana High School campus to discover the source.
